task: The person wants a saved-filters panel added to the invoices page of this Rails app. Ground that page before composing anything, and say where the panel would go.

steps.text: The invoices page is app/views/invoices/index.html.erb inside the application layout, with the shared/filters and invoices/row partials and the invoices stylesheet. The panel belongs above the table, at /section[0]/table[0]; I will anchor the region there and compose in the page's own idiom unless you would rather have an island.
